authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 section 4.7, R2004 literal run format
problem: The input reader supplied zero on an attempted read beyond compressed input and advanced the output counter. An incomplete declared literal could therefore appear to decode successfully.

minimal_reproduction_before_fix.explanation: Opcode 01 declares four literal bytes, but the compressed input contains only three.

change: Check input availability for the initial and subsequent literal copy, limited to bytes actually requested by the output window. Fail rather than synthesizing a zero. A complete literal ending at the physical input boundary remains an implicit end; explicit 0x11 and window-limited prefix decoding remain accepted.

validation.cases: Incomplete initial and post-backreference literals, valid retry on the same decoder, complete implicit and explicit end, output-window-limited prefix, missing reference offset, a complete reference ending at offset bytes with full and partial output windows, existing long literal/backreference and cursor-size guards.
validation.physical_result: All three existing DWG read CTests passed.

limits: This bounded literal-copy correction is separate from the system-page writer terminator and does not establish complete validation of all malformed compressed token encodings or successful ODA output.
